Name: Wizard's Mystical Stationery
Author: Taskmaster2
Description:
The Wizard of Pelican Town, M. Rasmodius, has recently acquired a cache of enchanted stationery — sourced from a mysterious contact at the Night Market and said to originate from the mystics of the Far East.

This mod adds 10 new, pixel-art style magical letter backgrounds for correspondence from the Wizard. You can choose your favorite design or let one be selected at random each time he writes. Whether it’s arcane scrollwork or celestial parchment, each style adds a touch of wonder to your mailbox.  They perfectly match the look and feel of Stardew Valley.

You can use the "standard images" (see Scroll and Potion Example screen shot) or the "muted" version (see Muted Hand Example), in case you have difficulty reading one version or the other.  You also have the option to include the original in-game stationery in the randomized rotation, should you chose.

I hope you will enjoy the variety!
